Overview.Name: Santosh Jami
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 3 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 2: Chicken curry (small bowl) + 1/2 cup cooked rice (~75 g)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) + 2 boiled eggs
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + curd + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Chicken curry (small portion) + 1/2 cup cooked rice (~75 g)
Option 2: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Curd bowl (thick) + vegetable curry (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: Since appearance is a major goal, keep rice controlled and make chicken or eggs the main portion.
Avoid fried snacks, especially during late-night boredom.
Fix dinner before 9 pm to reduce fat storage.
Start every meal with protein first before rice.
Low daily movement means portion control is important for visible fat loss.
Expect steady waist reduction in 10–12 weeks with consistency.
